description: This file contains unit tests for the BandwidthSampler class and related components in the QUIC congestion control module, including test fixtures, specific test cases for bandwidth sampling, ACK aggregation, and packet handling.

classes.name: BandwidthSamplerPeer
classes.description: Helper class providing access to internal state of BandwidthSampler for testing purposes.

classes.name: BandwidthSamplerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing BandwidthSampler behavior with different parameters.

classes.name: MaxAckHeightTrackerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing MaxAckHeightTracker's aggregation logic and epoch management.

methods.name: GetNumberOfTrackedPackets
methods.description: Returns the number of packets currently tracked by the BandwidthSampler.

methods.name: GetPacketSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a specific packet from the BandwidthSampler.

methods.name: PacketsToBytes
methods.description: Converts a packet count to total bytes based on the regular packet size.

methods.name: SendPacketInner
methods.description: Simulates sending a packet with specified parameters.

methods.name: SendPacket
methods.description: Simulates sending a packet with default size and retransmittable data.

methods.name: AckPacketInner
methods.description: Simulates acknowledging a packet and returns a bandwidth sample.

methods.name: MakeAckedPacket
methods.description: Creates an AckedPacket object for a given packet number.

methods.name: MakeLostPacket
methods.description: Creates a LostPacket object for a given packet number.

methods.name: AckPacket
methods.description: Acknowledges a packet and returns the observed bandwidth.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Simulates a congestion event with specified acknowledged and lost packets.

methods.name: LosePacket
methods.description: Simulates losing a packet and returns the last packet send state.

methods.name: Send40PacketsAndAckFirst20
methods.description: Sends 40 packets, acknowledges the first 20, then sends and acknowledges additional packets.

methods.name: RoundTripCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of round trips based on current time.
